_meta.theme: harness shakedown — probe round: small real tasks exercise the builtin loop (bash+write+edit) on each new free-pool worker; zai baseline included so UCB1 has a reference win-rate
_meta.design: T1 is the smallest real change (one function + one test) so a worker that survives it demonstrably completed a full write->build->test cycle through the native harness. T2 needs an edit to existing code (second tool path) plus a doc touch. Gates are the standard cargo gate; deliberately no openspec/coverage gate so failures point at the harness, not gate plumbing.
